pairs.subject: roll-call-vote-analysis
pairs.evidence: features/votetrack/components/RealRebellions.tsx:106 The named-person rebel ranking renders unconditionally; the reconciliation's discrepancy count only changes the colour of a note and never withholds the ranking, so the technique's 'gate claims affected by discrepancies' rule is not realized even though the delta is disclosed honestly.

techniques.evidence: features/votetrack/components/RealDisciplineBoard.tsx:297 Disclosure is good: one-to-one method, worst example with per-slot deltas, never repaired. But discrepancies>0 only switches the note to an ochre border. No derived ranking or person-level claim is withheld, and the standard says disclosure alone is not enough.

features/votetrack/components/RealRebellions.tsx:102 The capped top-rebels list ships the qualified population (counted before the slice) with the imported MIN_ELIGIBLE_VOTES floor; methodBody copy states the strict-majority line and that a tie sets no line.
features/votetrack/components/RealDisciplineBoard.tsx:85 Null cohesion renders as 'not measured' (—), not as 0 or 1; the MIN_CLUB_POSITIONAL floor is imported and disclosed in methodBody (line 245).

features/votetrack/components/RealDisciplineBoard.tsx:96 Each club row prints its own denominators (line votes for discipline, Rice-qualifying votes for cohesion) rather than implying 'all valid votes'.

pairs.subject: roll-call-vote-analysis
pairs.evidence: features/votetrack/kompas/score.ts:93 getKompas.ts drops ballots whose bucketOf() is null (unknown code) from the ballot map, and score.ts then defaults any missing ballot to "away", turning an undocumented code back into a published absence count. That is the second-mapping 'default arm' failure the vocabulary technique names.

techniques.evidence: features/votetrack/kompas/score.ts:93 derive.ts bucketOf has no default arm (returns null for unknown). The compass, though, filters null out in getKompas.ts:162 and re-defaults it to away here, so unknown ends up counted in awayCount.

features/votetrack/record/derive.ts:142 Strict majority with tie→no line, club-at-vote windows and a deterministic rate/count/name/id sort are all realized. But no per-division line-support rule exists (a 1:0 club tally sets a line). The copy does not say the scored member is included in the line. The rollup also keys per person with the first-seen club (line 384) and does not disclose per-club components for switchers.

features/votetrack/record/derive.ts:595 The procedure is exemplary (reconcile.ts: one-to-one slots, K = abstain+notVoting, away excluded, null recount kept separate from zero, deterministic worst example). But it is computed beside topRebels and never gates them, which misses the 'withhold derived rankings' decision rule.
features/votetrack/record/derive.ts:128 Bases come from the exported vocabulary sets, not re-listed; K and away never enter line/rebellion/Rice denominators.

features/votetrack/record/derive.ts:157 Positional base only, null without positional votes. Club means are gated by the imported MIN_CLUB_POSITIONAL (line 509). The chamber figure is positional-weighted, and an unmeasured day is null.

pairs.registryProposal: vote-choice-vocabulary-mapping's 'second mapping has no default arm' rule should also name the lookup-default variant: a consumer that filters unknown out of a sparse map and then defaults a missing key to 'away' reintroduces the same error without any bucketer having a default arm.
